english.prompt: A middle-income country pegs its currency to the dollar while banks and firms borrow heavily in dollars. Global interest rates rise, foreign lenders pull out, and emergency loans require spending cuts during a recession. Which factor best explains why the crisis is so hard to stop?
english.helpText: Choose the explanation that should guide the first response.

options.title: Domestic credibility failure
options.label: The currency peg and foreign-currency borrowing made an outside shock much worse. Rebuilding trust in domestic policy is the first condition for recovery.

options.title: Mixed crisis, mixed repair
options.label: Domestic policy choices and creditor leverage are both doing real work. Use temporary controls and renegotiate terms without abandoning the wider financial system.

options.title: Structural dependence exposed
options.label: The crisis exposes dependence on foreign-currency finance and creditor conditions. It will recur unless that dependence changes.

options.title: Domestic distributional conflict
options.label: External finance sets the constraint, but domestic politics determines which workers, firms, and regions absorb the cuts.

options.title: 复合危机需要多方面修复
options.label: 国内政策选择和债权人的制约都在起作用。应采取临时管制并重谈条件，同时不放弃更广泛的金融体系。

options.title: 结构性依赖暴露
options.label: 危机暴露了对外币融资和债权人条件的依赖。除非这种依赖发生变化，否则危机还会重演。

options.title: 国内分配冲突
options.label: 外部融资设定了约束，但国内政治决定哪些劳动者、企业和地区承担削减支出的代价。

literalBackTranslation.prompt: A middle-income state fixes its currency to the dollar while banks and firms borrow large dollar debts. Global rates rise, foreign lenders withdraw, and emergency loans demand spending cuts during recession. Which factor best explains why this crisis is so hard to contain?
literalBackTranslation.helpText: Choose the explanation that should guide the first response.

options.titleAndLabel: Domestic policy credibility fails. The fixed exchange rate and foreign-currency borrowing magnified the outside shock. Rebuilding trust in domestic policy is the first condition for recovery.

A compound crisis needs repair on several fronts. Domestic policy choices and creditor constraints both operate. Use temporary controls and renegotiate conditions without abandoning the broader financial system.
Structural dependence exposed. The crisis exposes dependence on foreign-currency finance and creditors’ terms. Unless this dependence changes, the crisis will recur.
Domestic distribution conflict. External finance sets constraints, but domestic politics decides which workers, businesses and regions bear the cost of spending cuts.

english.prompt: After a border clash, a rival withdraws some troops and accepts a military hotline, but keeps new missiles in place and faces nationalist pressure at home. Which evidence should anchor your judgment of whether de-escalation will last?
english.helpText: Choose the evidence you would trust first when the signals point in different directions.

options.title: Capabilities and posture
options.label: The missiles and remaining force posture matter most because they can be used regardless of promises or political language.

options.title: Institutions and commitments
options.label: Compliance with the pullback and use of the hotline matter most because observable commitments are harder to fake than public messages.

options.title: Domestic staying power
options.label: The best clue is whether leaders can contain nationalist pressure and keep domestic support for the quieter course.

options.title: Status and relationship signals
options.label: Watch whether leaders stop describing the dispute as a test of national standing; that shift can change what the remaining weapons mean.

servedChineseV1.prompt: 危机信息彼此冲突时，应优先相信哪一类证据？
servedChineseV1.helpText: 请选择你最先采用的判断依据。

options.title: 实际能力与军事态势
options.label: 若部队部署、战备态势和硬实力变化同其他信号相反，应把更大权重放在前者。

options.title: 制度约束与既有承诺
options.label: 条约履行、核查机制和危机规则会改变激励并提高虚张声势的成本，因此更有说明力。

options.title: 国内政治能否长期支撑
options.label: 应看领导层是否有足够的政治联盟、财政与公众空间，把当前政策坚持下去。

options.title: 地位诉求与关系信号

proposedChinese.prompt: 边境冲突后，对手撤回部分部队并同意设立军事热线，但仍保留新部署的导弹，国内也面临民族主义压力。判断局势缓和能否持续时，应以哪项证据为主要依据？
proposedChinese.helpText: 当信号指向不同方向时，请选择你会首先信任的证据。

options.title: 能力与军事态势
options.label: 导弹和剩余兵力的部署最重要，因为无论作出什么承诺或使用什么政治语言，这些力量都可以投入使用。

options.title: 制度与承诺
options.label: 是否遵守撤军安排、是否使用热线最重要，因为可观察的履约行为比公开表态更难伪装。

options.title: 国内政治能否持续支撑
options.label: 最有用的线索是领导人能否遏制民族主义压力，并保持国内对缓和路线的支持。

options.title: 地位与关系信号
options.label: 要看领导人是否不再把争端描述为对国家地位的考验；这种变化会改变剩余武器所传达的含义。

literalBackTranslation.prompt: After a border clash, a rival withdraws some troops and agrees to a military hotline, but retains newly deployed missiles and faces nationalist pressure at home. Which evidence should be the main basis for judging whether easing tensions can last?

options.titleAndLabel: Capabilities and military posture. Missiles and remaining deployments matter most, because these forces can be used whatever promises or political language are used.
Institutions and commitments. Whether the pullback is honored and hotline used matters most, because observable compliance is harder to fake than public statements.

Status and relationship signals. Watch whether leaders stop describing the dispute as a test of national standing; that change alters what the remaining weapons convey.

english.prompt: After a major insurgent attack, a Sahelian government is offered troops by its former colonial power. The force could help quickly, but earlier missions left resentment and weak local capacity. What should weigh most?
english.helpText: Answer from the Sahelian government's position.

options.title: Protect sovereignty and local control
options.label: Decline any arrangement that gives the outside force open-ended authority; short-term help is not worth renewed dependence.

options.title: Urgent danger can justify help
options.label: If civilians and state survival face extreme danger, tightly limited outside force can be justified despite the history.

options.title: Put regional actors in the lead
options.label: Accept help only through a mission whose aims, command, and exit terms are set mainly by neighboring states.

options.title: Judge the exit, not just the arrival
options.label: The decisive test is whether the mission leaves local forces and institutions stronger rather than creating another indefinite security dependency.

servedChineseV1.prompt: 邻国发生严重镇压，国际上出现动武干预的要求。一个有殖民经历的国家会怎样看这件事？
servedChineseV1.helpText: 请选择从该国政府角度最有说服力的判断。

options.title: 不能轻易降低干预门槛
options.label: 干预从来不是一视同仁地适用，弱国无法把它视为不偏不倚的规则。

options.title: 大规模杀戮可能构成真正例外
options.label: 高度重视主权，并不意味着面对极端暴行时永远拒绝外部行动。

options.title: 地区支持是关键检验
options.label: 如果例外由邻近国家共同界定目标与限制，而不是由远方大国单独包装，理由会更充分。

options.title: 评估干预之后会怎样
options.label: 要看外部武力究竟能保护民众，还是会加深崩溃与外部控制。

options.title: 先问干预之后会怎样

proposedChinese.prompt: 一次重大叛乱袭击后，萨赫勒地区某国政府收到来自其前殖民宗主国的派兵援助提议。这支部队可能迅速提供帮助，但以往的行动留下了怨恨，当地能力也依然薄弱。最应看重什么？
proposedChinese.helpText: 请站在这个萨赫勒国家政府的立场作答。

options.title: 保护主权和当地控制权
options.label: 拒绝任何给予外来部队无期限权限的安排；短期援助不值得以重新陷入依赖为代价。

options.title: 紧迫危险可以成为接受援助的理由
options.label: 如果平民和国家存续面临极端危险，即使存在这段历史，受到严格限制的外来武力也可以有正当理由。

options.title: 由地区国家主导
options.label: 只有当行动目标、指挥和退出条件主要由邻国决定时，才接受这一行动提供的援助。

options.title: 不仅看如何进入，也看如何退出
options.label: 决定性的检验是行动结束后，当地部队和机构是否更强，而不是再次形成没有明确期限的安全依赖。

Let regional states lead. Accept the mission’s assistance only when neighboring states mainly determine its aims, command and exit conditions.

english.prompt: A treaty ally finds that its main security partner has used force in clear breach of an agreement both signed. Suspending basing access would uphold the rule, but would also expose the ally to a nearby rival and threaten thousands of local jobs. What should govern its response?
english.helpText: Choose the priority that should govern the decision, not the easiest public message.

options.title: Suspend access now
options.label: A treaty ally cannot make the agreement credible while continuing to enable a clear breach, even at real security and economic cost.

options.title: Protect immediate security
options.label: Do not trade away the country's deterrent position or domestic coalition for a response it cannot safely sustain.

options.title: Reduce dependence in stages
options.label: Set a timetable to diversify security support and the local economy before using basing access as leverage.

options.title: Separate condemnation from access
options.label: Condemn the breach and press for a settlement, but keep the base arrangement in place unless the violation widens.

servedChineseV1.prompt: 政府反对一场对外侵略，但若迅速切断经济联系，国内物价将受到严重冲击。政策路线应由什么主导？
servedChineseV1.helpText: 请选择真正的政策优先项，不要按哪种公开表态最容易辩护来作答。

options.title: 尽快以实际行动捍卫规则
options.label: 承担真实代价，是防止侵略与夺取领土逐渐被正常化的一部分。

options.title: 先稳住国内社会与政治支持

options.title: 分阶段降低依赖

options.title: 反对侵略，同时保持外交回旋

proposedChinese.prompt: 一个条约盟国发现，其主要安全伙伴使用武力，明显违反了双方签署的协议。暂停基地使用权可以维护规则，却也会使该盟国更易受到邻近对手的威胁，并危及当地数千个就业岗位。应以什么原则指导回应？
proposedChinese.helpText: 请选择应当主导决策的优先事项，而不是最容易作出的公开表态。

options.title: 立即暂停使用权
options.label: 如果条约盟国继续为明显的违约行为提供条件，就无法使协议可信；即使要承担真实的安全和经济代价，也应暂停使用权。

options.title: 保障眼前的安全
options.label: 不要为了无法安全维持的回应，牺牲本国的威慑地位或国内政治联盟。

options.title: 分阶段降低依赖
options.label: 制定时间表，先使安全支持和当地经济更加多元，再将基地使用权作为施压手段。

options.title: 将谴责与使用权分开处理
options.label: 谴责违约并推动解决争端，但只要违规行为没有扩大，就维持基地安排。

literalBackTranslation.prompt: A treaty ally discovers that its principal security partner used force in clear violation of an agreement both signed. Suspending base-use rights can uphold the rule, but exposes the ally to a nearby rival and endangers thousands of local jobs. What principle should guide the response?
literalBackTranslation.helpText: Choose the priority that should govern the decision, not the easiest public message.

options.titleAndLabel: Suspend use rights immediately. A treaty ally cannot make the agreement credible if it continues enabling a clear breach; suspend rights even at real security and economic cost.
Protect immediate security. Do not sacrifice the country’s deterrent position or domestic coalition for a response it cannot safely sustain.
Reduce dependence in stages. Set a timetable first to diversify security support and the local economy, then use base rights as a means of pressure.
Handle condemnation separately from use rights. Condemn the breach and press to settle the dispute, but maintain the base arrangement so long as the violation does not widen.
